metadata.scope: AMR1 live shared SLAM map; AMR2 automatic dispatch after valid persisted target; person follows AMR2; mandatory AMR1 field recheck after exit candidate; AMR1 docking and AMR2 exit stop
metadata.applicability: 00_PC3대 and 01-11 are post-E2E PM design proposal using three_pc placement (application PCs 3 + dedicated Discovery PC4, total 4). Original 00 remains prior four-PC placement. OPS-87 E2E execution and current main #160 field Discovery topology stay separate; no runtime/IDL/config change.

amr1_dispatch_requirement.source: scope.md RQ-11 / Q-28; PM user clarification and repository-owner adoption (#85, 2026-10-11)
amr1_dispatch_requirement.source_quote: AMR1 출동 방식은 관제 모니터의 버튼으로 신호를 받아 출동하는거야
amr1_dispatch_requirement.event_behavior: Validate disaster event, display and persist evidence; await operator dispatch command.
amr1_dispatch_requirement.start_command: START_SEARCH; operator button remains. Transport status refers to baseline code, runtime not verified here.
amr1_dispatch_requirement.sequence: Operator dispatch command -> PrepareMapping(START) readiness -> ExecuteTask(SEARCH_AREA)
amr1_dispatch_requirement.historical_policy: The 2026-10-10 owner automatic-start record remains in scope Q-12; this PM requirement is not a claim of completed owner/team review.

legacy_amr2_escort_requirement.source: scope.md RQ-10 / Q-27; PM user request
legacy_amr2_escort_requirement.legacy_segment_interfaces: Existing MOVE_SEGMENT/CONTINUE_SEGMENT/ONE_SEGMENT definitions below describe segment navigation, not continuous following.

amr2_escort_requirement.source: PM request in #133 / scope branch docs/scenario-decisions-1012; owner adoption pending
amr2_escort_requirement.wire_contract: Reuse ExecuteTask type candidate; automatic admission/task-kind contract review pending. Never forge OperatorApproval or bypass MOVE_SEGMENT guards.

completion_requirement.speaker: PM (Codex user conversation), not repository owner
completion_requirement.source_quote: AMR1의 현장 재확인이 있어야 구조 완료 판정으로 이어져서 해당 로직은 필요함
completion_requirement.supersedes_same_day_quote: AMR1의 현장 재확인은 없애는 방향으로 진행할게
completion_requirement.guards: Validate exit candidate target/watch/boot/revision, timestamps and camera quality; dispatch linked AMR1 REOBSERVE_TARGET, move and stop, acquire fresh ObserveTarget camera ABSENT + LiDAR CLEAR + coverage VALID after candidate/accepted request; coordinator verifies matching task/target/frame and evidence then reports completion. UNKNOWN/present/invalid evidence never completes. Completion and docking/exit remain separately recorded.

shared_map_requirement.initialization: A: measured AMR1 map to AMR2 odom initial transform; B: LiDAR-based correction (AMCL candidate)
shared_map_requirement.tf_authority: One map->amr2.odom owner. A/B handover must stop/fence previous publisher; no parallel fixed and localization TF writers. Loop-closure/revision invalidation requires pause/revalidation.

terminal_requirement.amr1: dock approach, stopped, native Dock request, fresh is_docked=true and stopped
terminal_requirement.amr2: configured exit pose, arrived within validated tolerance and stopped, mission end; no return to initial pose
terminal_requirement.execute_task_mapping: Existing RETURN_HOME/home_ref may map to role-specific terminal reference only after C-06 admission semantics review. Exit is not silently treated as current home.

metadata.historical_pages: 01-11 synchronized to the three_pc source on 2026-10-13. Prior detailed diagrams preserved in Git before this revision.
metadata.external_reference: Dock/DockStatus type: https://github.com/iRobotEducation/create3_examples/blob/jazzy/create3_republisher/bringup/params.yaml; native installed version/QoS/namespace NOT_RUN

three_pc.speaker: PM (Codex user conversation)
three_pc.source_quote: PC1은 AMR1, PC2는 AMR2, PC3은 웹캠 및 웹, PC4는 discovery server 역할이다.
three_pc.transport_rule: Logical IF IDs/types/endpoints/source-target unchanged; central.discovery alone on dedicated PC4 (TurtleBot4/Fast DDS Discovery Server). PC3 camera/central/web/browser share one host. IF-086 discovery only; application Topic/Service/Action data are not centrally relayed by PC4. Browser HTTP only, web SQLite read-only, operations sole DB writer.
three_pc.validation: Concurrent camera/web/DB/DDS load, process isolation, failure recovery and deployment/network bindings NOT_RUN
three_pc.supersedes: Earlier same-day 3-total-PC proposal placed Discovery in PC3; superseded by explicit dedicated PC4 clarification.
three_pc.page_name_note: Keep user page name PC3대: three application PCs plus one dedicated Discovery PC, four physical PCs total.

detail_pages.source_quote: 나머지 01~11페이지의 sdd도 00 통합 시스템 설계도_PC3대를 베이스로 수정해줘.
detail_pages.deployment_boundary: Dedicated PC4 Discovery is PM proposal. main #160 records recommendation A: PCs directly connect to robot Pi servers; runtime/config unchanged.

interfaces.qos: RELIABLE / TRANSIENT_LOCAL / KEEP_LAST 1; 최신 전체 snapshot

interfaces.qos: RELIABLE / VOLATILE / KEEP_LAST 10; 중요 사건 outbox + 저장 receipt

interfaces.qos: RELIABLE / TRANSIENT_LOCAL / KEEP_LAST 1; 최신 전체 snapshot

interfaces.purpose: target_id와 ROI 연결을 설정; 확인된 보정 또는 운영자 ROI 연결 필요
AMR1 START_SEARCH·REQUEST_RECHECK·정지해제·복귀/종료·감시 설정 운영자 요청. 새 00 AMR2 초기 출동은 DISPATCH_SUPPORT/CONTINUE_SEGMENT에 의존하지 않음. REQUEST_RECHECK는 UNKNOWN 시 영상 판단 기록/재확인 요청이며 완료 승인 자체 아님
세션 인증된 운영 요청; STOP_ROBOT는 operations가 RequestStop로 우선 전달, 나머지는 coordinator 서비스로 전달
DB에 저장된 대상 좌표·보고 상태와 수신 시각이 있는 live 로봇 상태
PC3의 HTTP 영상 gateway를 PC4 브라우저가 조회
증거 원 bytes와 hash; ROS event는 EvidenceRef만 사용
AMR1 공유 지도의 snapshot/metadata/hash를 중앙에 저장하는 HTTP 계획. AMR2의 자기 지도 업로드 없음; 브라우저 live map 렌더는 미구현
DB 단일 writer 및 보고/증거 commit
참여자 ↔ 서버 발견 정보. Topic/Service/Action 데이터 흐름과 분리
도킹 위치 도착·실제 정지·fresh driver/도킹 준비 뒤 rescue_robot 운영 어댑터만 요청. 액션 응답은 물리 도킹 완료 아님
fresh is_docked=true와 실제 정지로 도킹 완료 확인. 이름/QoS/profile/native binding 검증 전

message_schemas.Envelope: schema_version:string, publisher_id:string, publisher_boot_id:UUID string, sequence:uint64, published_at_ns:int64. 전송 identity와 원 관측 identity를 분리.

message_schemas.FrameRef: robot_id:string, native_frame:string, mission_frame:string, map_session_id:UUID string, map_revision:uint64, transform_revision:uint64, alignment_status:string(VALID/DEGRADED/INVALID). 실제 frame 문자열은 profile 대응.
message_schemas.TargetObservation: envelope:Envelope, observation_id:UUID, source_robot:string, source_camera:string, source_boot_id:UUID, time:ObservationTime, class_label:string, confidence:float64, model_id:string, model_sha256:string, tracking_mode:string, has_track_id:bool, track_id:string, bbox_xyxy_pixels:float64[4], sensor_frame:string, localization_status:string(VALID/UNKNOWN/INVALID), sensor_position:geometry_msgs/Point, position_covariance:float64[9], depth_status:string, evidence:EvidenceRef. 탐지와 좌표 성공은 별도.
message_schemas.TargetLocation: envelope:Envelope, location_id:UUID, observation:TargetObservation, frame_ref:FrameRef, projection_status:string(VALID/STALE_DERIVATION/NEEDS_REOBSERVATION/EXPIRED), mission_position:geometry_msgs/Point, covariance:float64[9]. UNKNOWN 위치 수치는 사용 금지. 동일 location_id 재발행의 의미 payload는 불변.
message_schemas.MapState: envelope:Envelope, robot_id:string, snapshot_id:UUID, map_session_id:UUID, map_revision:uint64, map_update_sequence:uint64, generated_at_ns:int64, localization_quality:string, correction_detection_status:string(KNOWN/UNKNOWN), current_native_map_frame:string. 단순 TF tick마다 map_revision을 올리지 않음.
message_schemas.RobotPose: envelope:Envelope, robot_id:string, source_boot_id:UUID, time:ObservationTime, native_pose:geometry_msgs/PoseWithCovarianceStamped, mission_pose:geometry_msgs/PoseWithCovarianceStamped, frame_ref:FrameRef, mission_pose_status:string(VALID/UNKNOWN/INVALID). header stamp·frame과 time/ref 일치 검사.
message_schemas.FrameAlignmentSnapshot: envelope:Envelope, snapshot_id:UUID, alignments:FrameAlignment[]. 전체 snapshot이며 delta와 혼합하지 않음.
message_schemas.FrameAlignment: frame_ref:FrameRef, authority_id:string, transform:geometry_msgs/Transform, covariance:float64[36], valid_from_ns:int64, valid_until_ns:int64, status:string(VALID/DEGRADED/INVALID), calibration_evidence:EvidenceRef[]. 계측/검증 없는 alignment는 INVALID.
message_schemas.SearchCandidates: envelope:Envelope, robot_id:string, area_ref:string, frame_ref:FrameRef, generated_at_ns:int64, valid_until_ns:int64, candidate_poses:geometry_msgs/PoseStamped[], policy_version:string. 실제 주행은 executor의 유효 SEARCH_AREA task 안에서만.
message_schemas.Heartbeat: envelope:Envelope, robot_id:string, producer_role:string(EXECUTOR/WATCHDOG), robot_boot_id:UUID, authority_epoch:UUID, generation:uint64, emitted_at_ns:int64, command_fenced:bool. 수신자의 local monotonic watchdog과 별개.

message_schemas.CommandPermit: envelope:Envelope, permit_id:UUID, robot_id:string, robot_boot_id:UUID, authority_epoch:UUID, generation:uint64, lease_id:UUID, mode:string(ALLOW/FENCED), issued_at_ns:int64, valid_until_ns:int64, reason:string. 장치 로컬 watchdog은 유효 permit·fresh heartbeat·fresh 속도를 모두 확인.
message_schemas.RobotStatus: envelope:Envelope, robot_id:string, robot_boot_id:UUID, state_sequence:uint64, observed_at_ns:int64, authority_epoch:UUID, active_task_id:string, generation:uint64, readiness:string(READY/DEGRADED/NOT_READY/UNKNOWN), task_state:string, motion_state:string(STOPPED/MOVING/STOPPING/STOP_UNCONFIRMED), segment_index:uint32, stop_reason:string, stop_evidence:EvidenceRef[], dock_state:string(DOCKED/UNDOCKED/UNKNOWN), dock_observed_at_ns:int64, lease_valid:bool, sensor_quality:string, nav2_state:string, battery_known:bool, battery_fraction:float64. 미확인 값을 정상으로 채우지 않음.
message_schemas.TaskAdmission: envelope:Envelope, admission_id:UUID, command_id:UUID, task_id:UUID, robot_id:string, robot_boot_id:UUID, authority_epoch:UUID, generation:uint64, accepted:bool, reason_code:string, observed_at_ns:int64. goal accepted=false의 상세 이유 및 수락 장부의 근거.
message_schemas.TargetEstimate: target_id:UUID, estimate_revision:uint64, locations:TargetLocation[], latest_observed_at_ns:int64, valid_until_ns:int64, mission_position:geometry_msgs/Point, covariance:float64[9], confirmation_state:string(CANDIDATE/CONFIRMED/NEEDS_REOBSERVATION/DISMISSED), approach_state:string(UNASSIGNED/ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS/APPROACH_COMPLETE/BLOCKED/UNREACHABLE/CANCELED/FAILED), segment_phase:string(IDLE/EVALUATING/AWAITING_APPROVAL/EXECUTING/STOPPING/STOPPED/UNKNOWN), rescue_state:string(NOT_CHECKED/RECHECK_NEEDED/RESCUE_CONFIRMED), persisted_report_id:string. locations가 관측별 provenance를 보존. message_schemas.TargetSnapshot: envelope:Envelope, snapshot_id:UUID, targets:TargetEstimate[]. 전체 상태 snapshot. 웹의 저장 완료 좌표 표시는 operations 장부 기준.
message_schemas.SystemState: envelope:Envelope, state_sequence:uint64, mode:string(NORMAL/DISASTER/MISSION_FINISHED), changed_at_ns:int64, cause_event_ids:UUID[], active_task_ids:UUID[], policy_version:string, reason:string, phase:string(IDLE/DISASTER/SEARCHING/TARGET_FOUND/DISPATCH_APPROVED/SEGMENT_MOVING/AWAITING_CONTINUE/ARRIVED/CANDIDATE/RECHECKING/RESCUE_CONFIRMED/RECHECK_NEEDED/RETURNING/FINISHED), has_trigger:bool, trigger_event_id:UUID, trigger_observed_at_ns:int64, has_dispatch:bool, target_id:UUID, target_revision:uint64, route_revision:uint64, segment_index:uint32, segment_count:uint32, segment_phase:string(IDLE/EVALUATING/AWAITING_APPROVAL/EXECUTING/STOPPING/STOPPED/UNKNOWN). phase 이하는 2026-10-11 1차 채택 때 임무 화면용으로 더함(contracts C-10). Phase 1 은 AMR2 출동 대상이 한 번에 하나라 출동 정보를 이 snapshot 에 둔다
message_schemas.SiteEvent: envelope:Envelope, event_id:UUID, camera_id:string(cam_fixed 예시), source_boot_id:UUID, kind:string(DISASTER_SIGN/TARGET_DISAPPEARED_CANDIDATE), time:ObservationTime, target_id:string, watch_id:string, confidence:float64, visibility_state:string(VALID/OCCLUDED/UNKNOWN), metrics_name:string[], metrics_value:float64[], policy_version:string, evidence:EvidenceRef. 재난 징후는 target/watch 비어 있음; 소실 후보는 둘 다 필수.

message_schemas.RecheckObservation: observation_id:UUID, task_id:UUID, target_id:UUID, robot_id:string, source_boot_id:UUID, time:ObservationTime, frame_ref:FrameRef, watched_native_point:geometry_msgs/Point, camera_state:string(PRESENT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN), lidar_state:string(BLOCKED/CLEAR/UNKNOWN), coverage_state:string(VALID/INVALID/UNKNOWN), sensor_window_start_ns:int64, sensor_window_end_ns:int64, detector_health:string, evidence:EvidenceRef[]. EMPTY 탐지 배열만으로 ABSENT 금지; 실제 시야/거리/센서 품질이 필요.

message_schemas.RouteCandidate: route_id:UUID, route_revision:uint64, robot_id:string, target_id:string, segment_index:uint32, frame_ref:FrameRef, planned_path:nav_msgs/Path, approach_goal:geometry_msgs/PoseStamped, generated_at_ns:int64, valid_until_ns:int64, path_sha256:string, approval_corridor_sha256:string, assessment:PassageAssessment, planner_evidence_id:string, policy_version:string. 대상 좌표·접근 목표는 다른 값.
message_schemas.OperatorApproval: approval_id:UUID, command_id:UUID, operator_id:string(서버 인증값), robot_id:string, robot_boot_id:UUID, authority_epoch:UUID, target_id:string, target_estimate_revision:uint64, route_id:UUID, route_revision:uint64, segment_index:uint32, approved_at_ns:int64, valid_until_ns:int64, scope:string(ONE_SEGMENT). 같은 구간의 같은 의미만 멱등 허용.
message_schemas.RescueReport: envelope:Envelope, report_id:UUID, target_id:string, task_id:string, generation:uint64, record_ids:UUID[], locations:TargetLocation[], site_events:SiteEvent[], rechecks:RecheckObservation[], routes:RouteCandidate[], approvals:OperatorApproval[], task_admissions:TaskAdmission[], has_task_result:bool, task_result:TaskResult, confirmation_state:string, approach_state:string, rescue_state:string, evidence_refs:EvidenceRef[], first_issued_at_ns:int64, meaning_sha256:string. 해당 기록이 없는 optional section은 명시적으로 빈 배열/has flag.
message_schemas.ReportReceipt: envelope:Envelope, receipt_id:UUID, report_id:UUID, meaning_sha256:string, included_record_ids:UUID[], state:string(RECEIVED/PENDING_EVIDENCE/PERSISTED/REJECTED), persisted_at_ns:int64, has_persisted_at:bool, storage_revision:uint64, reason_code:string. included_record_ids는 저장한 보고의 내용과 일치.
message_schemas.TaskResult: task_id:UUID, command_id:UUID, robot_id:string, generation:uint64, outcome:string(COMPLETED/CANCELED/EXPIRED/UNREACHABLE/FAILED), completion_scope:string(SEARCH/SEGMENT/TARGET_APPROACH/RECHECK/RETURN/HOLD), terminal_reason:string, original_cause:string, stop_confirmed:bool, motion_state:string, final_pose:RobotPose, used_record_ids:UUID[], frame_ref:FrameRef, recheck:RecheckObservation, has_recheck:bool, stop_evidence:EvidenceRef[]. 구간 성공을 접근/구조 성공으로 바꾸지 않음.

SubmitOperatorCommand.Request: envelope:Envelope, command_id:UUID, operation:string(START_SEARCH/DISPATCH_SUPPORT/CONTINUE_SEGMENT/REQUEST_RECHECK/RETURN_HOME/FINISH_MISSION/RESET_STOP/SET_CAMERA_WATCH), operator_id:string(operations 인증값), robot_id:string, target_id:string, expected_task_id:string, expected_generation:uint64, expected_target_revision:uint64, route_id:string, route_revision:uint64, segment_index:uint32, issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64, roi_xyxy_normalized:float64[4], association_evidence_id:string. operation별 필수 필드는 검증; 나머지는 명시적 비적용.
SubmitOperatorCommand.Response: envelope:Envelope, accepted:bool, command_id:UUID, request_state:string(ACCEPTED/REJECTED/DUPLICATE), reason_code:string, created_task_id:string, approval_id:string. accepted는 접수이며 이동·구조·저장 완료가 아님.
SubmitOperatorCommand.Rules: 웹 operator_id 문자열을 신뢰하지 않고 서버 세션에서 설정. CONTINUE_SEGMENT는 현재 STOPPED, 이전 구간 종료, 해당 route/target revision, ONE_SEGMENT 승인 및 유효시간이 모두 맞을 때만 접수. 장부 재전송은 같은 command_id/의미 payload. SET_CAMERA_WATCH는 서버가 profile의 TARGET_WATCH 카메라 1대·ROI와 확인된 target_id를 결합한다. coordinator가 watch_id를 발급하고 association_method=OPERATOR_ROI, association_evidence_id=command_id로 SetCameraWatch를 요청하며 수락된 boot/revision을 기록한다. 거절은 상태로 보고하고 활성 감시로 기록하지 않는다.

RequestStop.Request: envelope:Envelope, stop_command_id:UUID, requester_id:string, authority_epoch:string, robot_id:string, scope:string(ACTIVE_TASK/ALL_MOTION), reason_code:string, issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64.
RequestStop.Rules: 일반 임무보다 우선 접수. callback에서 실제 정지를 기다리지 않음. 후속 RobotStatus STOPPED/STOP_UNCONFIRMED 및 TaskResult로 판정. 권한 있는 정지 요청은 활성 task ID를 몰라도 가능.

RegisterAuthority.Request: envelope:Envelope, command_id:UUID, robot_id:string, expected_robot_boot_id:UUID, coordinator_id:string, authority_epoch:UUID, policy_version:string, issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64.
RegisterAuthority.Rules: 기존 이동/제어권 종료와 실제 정지 확인 후 등록. authority_epoch UUID의 크기로 신구 판단하지 않음. 등록은 ARMED 절차의 일부이고 lease/이동 허가를 자동 생성하지 않음.

ResetStop.Request: envelope:Envelope, reset_command_id:UUID, robot_id:string, expected_robot_boot_id:UUID, authority_epoch:UUID, expected_latch_id:UUID, resolved_reason_code:string, issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64.
ResetStop.Rules: 현장 E-stop/fault 해제를 대신하지 않음. 정지·원인 해결·live readiness·권한 확인 후 software latch만 해제. 이전 task 자동 재개 없음; 새 generation 필요.

SetCameraWatch.Request: envelope:Envelope, command_id:UUID, camera_id:string, watch_id:UUID, target_id:UUID, expected_watch_revision:uint64, roi_xyxy_normalized:float64[4], association_method:string(CALIBRATED_PROJECTION/OPERATOR_ROI), association_evidence_id:string, enable:bool, issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64.
SetCameraWatch.Rules: ROI [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]는 0≤min<max≤1. 카메라별 활성 watch 1개이며 profile TARGET_WATCH 카메라가 정확히 1대일 때만 무장. watch_id는 (camera_id,target_id,ROI)에 고정하고 변경 시 새 UUID. watch_revision은 카메라 감시 슬롯의 교체·해제 번호, 0은 비어 있음이며 재결합 키가 아니다. 교체/해제는 expected_watch_revision을 검사하며 해제는 활성 watch_id·ROI도 일치해야 함. 빈 UUID·열거/기본 생성값은 거절. image_size/camera_pose 변경·어댑터 재시작 시 watch 무효화. 수락 응답의 publisher_boot_id와 revision을 저장하고 낡거나 boot/watch 불일치한 상태는 UNKNOWN. target_id 없이 소실 이벤트 발행하지 않음. 재관측 트리거는 SiteEvent(TARGET_DISAPPEARED_CANDIDATE)만이며 TargetPresence.ABSENT_CANDIDATE는 표시용. 카메라를 robot_id 목록에 넣지 않음.

ApproveOverheadPassage.Rules: 터널 진입 금지 해제(재범 결정 2026-10-16 A). overhead_passage 판정 목록에 지금 있는 item_id 만 받는다. approved_by(사람 이름)는 비면 거절. 수락하면 그 자리(merge_radius_m 안)를 이번 회차 동안 진입 금지 지도에서 빼고, 그 뒤 같은 자리에서 다시 BLOCKED 를 재도 빠진 채다. 누가·언제·어느 자리를 풀었는지 로그에 남긴다. 로봇을 움직이지 않는다.

PrepareMapping.Goal: envelope:Envelope, request_id:UUID, robot_id:string, operation:string(PREPARE/START), baseline_map_ref:string, mapping_profile_id:string, expected_map_session_id:string, issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64.
PrepareMapping.Rules: AMR1은 사전 지도 없이 scan·TF 기반 SLAM 준비/시작. AMR2는 AMR1의 fresh map/session/revision과 자기 정렬 TF·LiDAR 위치 추정 준비를 확인하고 지도를 발행하지 않는다 [POST_E2E 제안]. 기존 PREPARE/START fields는 호환 보존; 로봇 역할별 backend binding 계약 확정 전 적용 불가. 단순 process/토픽 수신을 READY로 표시하지 않음.

ExecuteTask.Goal: envelope:Envelope, command_id:UUID, task_id:UUID, robot_id:string, expected_robot_boot_id:UUID, coordinator_id:string, authority_epoch:UUID, generation:uint64, kind:string(SEARCH_AREA/APPROACH_TARGET/REOBSERVE_TARGET/HOLD/MOVE_SEGMENT/RETURN_HOME), issued_at_ns:int64, deadline_ns:int64, lease_id:UUID, target_id:string, target_estimate_revision:uint64, search_area_ref:string, home_ref:string, frame_ref:FrameRef, route:RouteCandidate, has_route:bool, approval:OperatorApproval, has_approval:bool, policy_version:string.
ExecuteTask.Feedback: envelope:Envelope, task_id:UUID, generation:uint64, state:string(VALIDATING/PLANNING/NAVIGATING/VERIFYING/STOPPING), segment_index:uint32, current_pose:RobotPose, distance_remaining_known:bool, distance_remaining_m:float64, reason_code:string. UNKNOWN pose/distance는 status/known=false로 명시하고 숫자 사용 금지.
ExecuteTask.Rules: 로봇당 활성 이동 1개와 권한/lease·준비·취소→실제 정지 관문 유지. POST_E2E PM 요구안은 AMR2 자동 접근이며 kind/approval admission 계약 개정 전 실행 불가. 기존 MOVE_SEGMENT·ONE_SEGMENT/CONTINUE_SEGMENT는 10-13 E2E/과거 wire 정의로 보존하고 무승인 의미로 재해석하지 않음. AMR1 RETURN_HOME은 도킹 접근, 실제 Dock는 별도 운영 절차; AMR2 출구 종료는 역할별 terminal reference/task mapping 계약 미정. 목표 좌표/종료 참조/정지 허용치 불명은 거절·보류.

EvaluateRoute.Goal: envelope:Envelope, request_id:UUID, robot_id:string, target_id:string, target_estimate_revision:uint64, purpose:string(APPROACH/SEGMENT/RECHECK/RETURN), segment_index:uint32, candidate_goal:geometry_msgs/PoseStamped, has_candidate_goal:bool, home_ref:string, frame_ref:FrameRef, footprint_profile_id:string, policy_version:string, deadline_ns:int64.
EvaluateRoute.Rules: executor가 ComputePathToPose를 호출하고 AMR2는 필요한 구간에서 EvaluatePassage를 호출. 주행 없음. 승인은 평가된 route corridor/segment/revision에 결합. 재계획이 승인 범위를 벗어나거나 의미 있는 지도/위치/평가 변화이면 승인 무효화·정지·재평가. 계산 실패를 경로 가능으로 대체하지 않음.

ObserveTarget.Goal: envelope:Envelope, request_id:UUID, task_id:UUID, target_id:UUID, robot_id:string, watched_native_point:geometry_msgs/Point, frame_ref:FrameRef, requested_window_ns:uint64, policy_version:string, deadline_ns:int64.
ObserveTarget.Rules: AMR1 완료 재확인과 AMR2 도착 인형 재탐지에 재사용. 완료용 AMR1 관측은 연결된 출구 소실 후보 또는 수락된 REQUEST_RECHECK 이후에 현장 이동·정지한 뒤 새 관측 창에서 취득한다. target/frame/task/시각·시야 유효성 확인 뒤 camera ABSENT·LiDAR CLEAR·coverage VALID를 각각 보고하며 coordinator가 이 세 조건과 후보 연결을 검증한다. 취소/timeout/가림/불확실은 UNKNOWN, 부재 성공으로 위조하지 않음.

EvaluatePassage.Goal: envelope:Envelope, request_id:UUID, route_id:UUID, route_revision:uint64, segment_index:uint32, path:nav_msgs/Path, frame_ref:FrameRef, footprint_profile_id:string, policy_version:string, deadline_ns:int64.
EvaluatePassage.Rules: footprint_profile은 로봇 box의 폭·높이·길이·하중 포함 envelope와 불확실성/안전 여유를 정의. 경로 swept volume 전체의 바닥/천장·폭을 평가. 상부 3D 여유가 알려지지 않으면 UNKNOWN. 2D LiDAR만으로 기울어진 기둥 하부 통과 승인 금지. 카메라 box overlay는 검토용 증거이며 PASSABLE 계산을 대신하지 않음.

standard_action_notes.nav2_msgs/action/NavigateToPose: Goal은 stamped 목표 pose와 BT 선택, Feedback은 현재 pose·진행 시간/거리, Result는 오류 코드/메시지. 성공과 실제 정지·대상 재확인은 분리.
standard_action_notes.nav2_msgs/action/ComputePathToPose: Goal은 목표·시작 pose와 planner 선택/시작 사용 여부, Result는 path·계산 시간·오류. Jazzy feedback에는 사용자 필드 없음. 경로 조회는 로봇 이동 아님.
standard_action_notes.nav2_msgs/action/FollowPath: Goal은 경로 및 controller/checker 선택, Feedback은 추종 거리/속도, Result는 오류. Nav2 내부 bt→controller 연결.

retired_interfaces.purpose: 새 00은 AMR1 공유 지도만 사용. AMR2 지도 발행 경로는 과거 01~11쪽에만 보존하고 번호를 재사용하지 않음.
retired_interfaces.qos: RELIABLE / TRANSIENT_LOCAL / KEEP_LAST 1; 최신 전체 snapshot
